individuals.treatment_summary: Prednisone 15 mg per day, methotrexate 15 mg per week and thalidomide 50 mg per night; methotrexate replaced with tacrolimus and leflunomide successively for recurrent erythema nodosa; symptoms significantly improved, ESR and CRP normalised; she stopped taking medicine last year.
individuals.clinical_diagnosis_basis: Clinical features and genetic testing (whole-exome sequencing) identifying a heterozygous TNFAIP3 variant

variants.parental_testing_statement: Genetic analysis confirmed the presence of the TNFAIP3 A547T variant in her symptomatic mother and sisters.
variants.functional_evidence_statement: No functional studies: 'Due to the lack of functional studies for personal reasons of the patient, the accurate pathogenic significance of A547T was indeed unknown.' I-TASSER 3D homology model: the alanine-to-threonine replacement at residue 547 resulted in altered hydrogen bond interactions (hydrogen bond distance: WT 2.1, A547T 2.2) with residue 551 and the overall three-dimensional structure of the protein. Minor allele frequency < 0.0001 in the Asian population.
variants.pathogenicity_as_stated_by_authors: novel; Abstract: 'validated to be pathogenic in our study'; Discussion: 'the accurate pathogenic significance of A547T was indeed unknown'

individuals.clinical_diagnosis_basis: Clinical features and gene testing detecting a heterozygous TNFAIP3 c.1906+2T>G variant

variants.functional_evidence_statement: Minor allele frequency < 0.0001 in the Asian population; Alamut predicted it might affect splicing; splice sites analysed with NetGene2 and BDGP. RT-PCR (P2 blood RNA): an additional band between 2500 bp and 3000 bp, about 500-1000 bp longer than the 1998 bp wild-type band, suggesting intron 7 retention; the variant was more dominant than WT at the transcriptional level. Immunoblot of P2 PBMCs: reduced basal, TNF-alpha- or LPS-induced A20 expression; more pronounced phosphorylation of IKK and NF-kB; exaggerated NLRP3 and pro-IL-1beta after LPS or TNF-alpha stimulation. TNF-alpha, IL-6 and IL-1beta increased in plasma and PBMC culture supernatant compared with controls.
